issues.issue: All three two-hop routes connect Poarta Sărutului to Oltenia through factual distinctive relations: its sculptor and his natal region, its city and that city’s region, or its ensemble and its location. The municipal Brâncuși center verifies sculpture, author, ensemble and Târgu Jiu. The local university places Târgu Jiu in Oltenia; primary cultural publications locate Brâncuși’s birth in Hobița/Gorj. No arbitrary pan-Romanian regional cuisine association is used. New neutral captions require their own exact review. Sources: https://centrulbrancusi.ro/poarta-sarutului-2/ ; https://vechi.utgjiu.ro/admitere/admitere-master/despre-tgjiu/ ; https://biblioteca-digitala.ro/reviste/Brancusi_centrul-brancusi/Brancusi_02_2014-centrul-brancusi.pdf .
